svg.aria-label: The whole periodic table drawn as 18 columns and 7 rows of small boxes, each with a symbol and its atomic number, with a dashed arrow running along each row from left to right and dropping to the start of the next row: the numbers run 1, 2 across the top row, 3 to 10 across the second, and on down to 118; group numbers 1 to 18 across the top and period numbers 1 to 7 down the side; a note says the 30 elements 57 to 71 and 89 to 103 are left out
svg.text: 1, 2 … then 3 to 10 on the next row … and on down to 118
57–71 and 89–103 are 30 more metals, usually printed in two extra rows; this drawing leaves them out.
